scope: REVENUE-MS-TRAIN — training cadence layer (orthogonal to MS0-MS5)
orthogonality: Touches every revenue product (SFC, Master Post, WEDM, Lathe, Mill, Quote-to-Ship). MS0-MS5 ship envelope-baseline; MS-TRAIN converts envelope to per-customer fit.
customer_promise: Day 1 ISO-baseline + envelope margins. Day 30 fitted Kienzle/Taylor/operator-style. Day 90 conformal-validated autonomy.

depends_on.round3_5_agent3: 11 SFC training nodes (Kienzle, Taylor, SLD, thermal, conformal, mill_lora r16, lathe_lora r8, wedm_lora r4, cam_lora ensemble, tribal capture, telemetry fabric)
depends_on.round3_5_agent5: Master Post per-controller training (Hurco/Okuma/Mitsubishi-wire ship-ready; Haas/Fanuc/Mitsubishi-sinker missing; operator-style LoRAs; 3 tribal overlays)
depends_on.round3_agent9: T3 LoRA plan (QLoRA r=16/8/4/8, qwen2.5-coder:7b base, Ollama adapter mounting, .safetensors weights storage, fallback-marker telemetry contract)

training_nodes.name: Kienzle kc11 per-shop per-material
training_nodes.validation_gate: R^2>0.92, CI half-width <8%, Bayesian deviation penalty >30% from ISO
training_nodes.fallback: ISO baseline + 12% conformal margin + telemetry kienzle.fallback.baseline_only

training_nodes.name: Taylor C/n per-machine per-tool-class
training_nodes.validation_gate: n CI excludes 0 and >0.6, R^2>0.80, 20% holdout
training_nodes.fallback: machine-specific -> shop-avg -> ISO baseline tier label

training_nodes.name: SLD per-machine per-toolholder-stack
training_nodes.fit_method: FRF FFT + rational-fraction-polynomial + Altintas-Budak + RCSA Schmitz Ch.4
training_nodes.validation_gate: chatter RPM within +/-8% of 3 cut-test verifications, modes >=3 in 0-4000Hz

training_nodes.name: Thermal growth per-machine per-axis
training_nodes.validation_gate: RMSE <5um tight-tol or <15um general, alpha plausible 1-3 um/C cast-iron 5-12 spindle
training_nodes.fallback: worst-case 25um drift in tolerance stack, block IT5/IT6 parts

training_nodes.name: Conformal recalibration drift detection
training_nodes.fit_method: Adaptive Conformal Prediction (Romano 2020 APS) + CUSUM drift detector
training_nodes.fallback: widen alpha 0.10->0.15, block dispatcher until 20-sample recalibration window completes

training_nodes.name: mill_lora rank-16
training_nodes.fit_method: QLoRA r=16 alpha=32 dropout=0.1 q_proj+v_proj, 3 epochs lr=2e-4 cosine, CE+KL
training_nodes.validation_gate: S/F token-acc >75% +/-5%, strategy F1>0.82, >8% lift vs no-adapter
training_nodes.fallback: lora-weights-presence-check Stop hook blocks dispatcher, base qwen2.5-coder + telemetry lora.fallback.weights_missing

training_nodes.name: lathe_lora rank-8
training_nodes.fit_method: QLoRA r=8 alpha=16, JM Die .MIN $<INTERNAL>% corpus

training_nodes.name: cam_lora ensemble rank-8
training_nodes.validation_gate: op top-1>0.88, strategy top-3 recall>0.90, tool top-5>0.85

training_nodes.name: Tribal continuous capture
training_nodes.fit_method: embedding-only (Xenova all-MiniLM-L6-v2 384-dim) + Ollama zero-shot tag extraction, promote >=3 citations
training_nodes.validation_gate: /wiki-lint, anti-dup cosine>0.85 flag, FP tag-extraction <10% monthly audit

training_nodes.name: Unified telemetry-ingestion fabric (5-protocol)
training_nodes.fit_method: stream consolidation to Qdrant + DuckDB + Stop-hook triggers
training_nodes.fallback: per-protocol degrade with telemetry tier degraded-{protocol}

operator_style_lora.signal: $<INTERNAL>% header, hand-edit patterns, G10 L2 work-offset placement
pulse-table preset selection, jump-flush thresholds, electrode-wear compensation cadence

tribal_overlays.rule: After M30 emit G0 X0 Y0 Z0 (Hurco WinMAX leaves spindle at last position; JM convention)
Line 1 MUST be $<INTERNAL>% (controller refuses load otherwise)
PROVEN PRG/ folder name distinguishes proven vs draft programs in archive ingestion + downstream confidence-tier
tribal_overlays.test: archive ingest tags prg_status: draft|proven by parent folder name

critical_data_gaps.risk: JM Die may not have shop-floor downtime or skilled technician in-house

critical_data_gaps.mitigation: PRISM technician on-site (billable onboarding-day premium) OR train one JM machinist on FRF protocol (3-day cert) OR accept class-default SLD and revisit month 3

Impact hammer PCB 086C03 + tri-axial accelerometer PCB 356A16 (mobile cart, one set per shop)
Touch probe Renishaw OMP60 — thermal warmup + workpiece alignment
Spindle temperature thermocouple — internal, expose via FOCAS/THINC parameter
Ambient temperature DS18B20 1-wire — $5 retrofit per machine column
Shop-floor UI + microphone for tribal capture (existing web frontend + commodity USB mic)
Operator tool-life logger (UI-driven, no hardware sensor)

summary.svi_omega_impact: MS-TRAIN lifts active milestone bundle from envelope-Omega ~0.75 to fit-Omega target 1.0; conformal coverage >=85% per (op, machine, material) cell is binding constraint
summary.verdict: MS-TRAIN is the only milestone that converts envelope-baseline physics into per-customer fit + LoRA adapter weights + tribal continuous capture. Without it, MS0-MS5 ship at envelope-Omega and the premium SaaS tier (which justifies revenue) has no value-perception anchor.
summary.one_line: 20 units, 11 calibration nodes + 6 LoRA adapters + 3 tribal overlays + 5-protocol telemetry fabric; 10h onboarding + 2h/month operator overhead + 6-8 automated jobs/month; 3 critical gaps (spindle-power telemetry, tool-life log cold-start, FRF measurement downtime) gate the premium-tier value-add.
